rationale: HUT is trading at 92% of its intraday range with only 24 minutes to close, meaning the stock has already made its large move (from $66.90 low to near $77.09 high). Entering long near the top of a wide-range day with a forced market-close liquidation in 24 minutes creates asymmetric risk — any mean reversion toward VWAP ($69.94) would be catastrophic, and the last few candles show a slight pullback from the session high. A short near the high is tempting but the 9-EMA ($75.79) is rising and price is holding above it, offering no clean mechanical edge in either direction with this time constraint.
